description:
Create a directional street map for an event invitation in Wondershare EdrawMax. 

Starting from the Home screen, navigate to the 'Maps' or 'Directional Map' category and create a new blank drawing. 

Draw a map with the following specific elements:
1. A street intersection (Cross or T-shape).
2. Label one road 'Main Street'.
3. Label the intersecting road 'Oak Avenue'.
4. Add a building/landmark shape at a corner and label it 'Grand Convention Center'.
5. Add a parking symbol or area labeled 'Parking'.
6. Add an arrow or label indicating the 'Entrance'.

Save the editable diagram as '/home/ga/Documents/event_map.eddx' and export a PNG image as '/home/ga/Documents/event_map.png'.

(Note: Dismiss any 'temporarily saved files' banners if they appear.)
